description: Defines the main view component for a to-do list application using the Enyo framework, including UI elements and event handlers.

classes.name: ToDo.NotepadMainView
classes.description: Main view component for the to-do list, managing task display and user interactions.

methods.name: markAllComplete
methods.description: Handles the event to mark all tasks as complete by bubbling 'onMarkAllComplete'.

methods.name: rendered
methods.description: Called when the component is rendered; triggers a reload event.

methods.name: throwEdit
methods.description: Enables editing of a task label on double-click.

methods.name: sendEnter
methods.description: Handles the Enter key press in input fields to finalize editing.

methods.name: sendEsc
methods.description: Handles the Escape key press to cancel editing.

methods.name: markComplete
methods.description: Marks individual tasks as complete when checkbox is clicked.
